Reminders

Before you begin, here is a quick reminder of the key points from the instructions and tips:

  • Each card's chance of winning is independent of the other cards — choose based on each card on its own.
  • A card's chance of winning can change over time, so stay focused round to round.
  • The location of the cards is random — select only based on the card you see, not its position on the screen.
  • You will be able to track your gold coins in real time at the top of the screen.
  • Note: your gold coins can go below 0 if you keep losing — there is no floor.
